tasks.label: coreclr: Build Signed MacCatalyst
args: IDENTITY=$(security find-identity -v -p codesigning | awk -F '"' '/Apple Development:/ { print $2; exit }'); if [ -z "$IDENTITY" ]; then echo 'No Apple Development identity found. Open Xcode > Settings > Accounts > Manage Certificates.' >&2; exit 1; fi; export GRENSHOT_MAC_CODESIGN_KEY="$IDENTITY"; scripts/maui-maccatalyst-dev.sh build

tasks.label: coreclr: Start Current Signed MacCatalyst
args: APP_PATH="$PWD/src/Greenshot.Maui/bin/Debug/net10.0-maccatalyst/maccatalyst-arm64/Greenshot.app"; APP_EXECUTABLE="$APP_PATH/Contents/MacOS/Greenshot.Maui"; if [ ! -x "$APP_EXECUTABLE" ]; then echo 'Build the signed app first with coreclr: Build Signed MacCatalyst.' >&2; exit 1; fi; pkill -f "$APP_EXECUTABLE" || true; open -n "$APP_PATH"; for _ in {1..20}; do pgrep -f "$APP_EXECUTABLE" >/dev/null && exit 0; sleep 0.5; done; echo 'Greenshot app did not launch in time.' >&2; exit 1

tasks.label: coreclr: Rebuild and Start Signed MacCatalyst
args: IDENTITY=$(security find-identity -v -p codesigning | awk -F '"' '/Apple Development:/ { print $2; exit }'); if [ -z "$IDENTITY" ]; then echo 'No Apple Development identity found. Open Xcode > Settings > Accounts > Manage Certificates.' >&2; exit 1; fi; export GRENSHOT_MAC_CODESIGN_KEY="$IDENTITY"; APP_PATH="$PWD/src/Greenshot.Maui/bin/Debug/net10.0-maccatalyst/maccatalyst-arm64/Greenshot.app"; APP_EXECUTABLE="$APP_PATH/Contents/MacOS/Greenshot.Maui"; scripts/maui-maccatalyst-dev.sh build; pkill -f "$APP_EXECUTABLE" || true; open -n "$APP_PATH"; for _ in {1..20}; do pgrep -f "$APP_EXECUTABLE" >/dev/null && exit 0; sleep 0.5; done; echo 'Greenshot app did not launch in time.' >&2; exit 1
